priority.description: This feature is not supported for MlJobOptions

disabled.description: This feature is not supported for MlJobOptions

maxConcurrency.description:
Upper bound on total number of batches of models to calculate health for simultaneously.
See {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Result}.

maxConcurrencyPerNode.description: This feature is not supported for MlJobOptions

runAsUser.description: This feature is not supported for MlJobOptions

nodePool.description: This feature is not supported for MlJobOptions

skipIfRunning.description: This feature is not supported for MlJobOptions

numAutoRecoveryAttempts.description: Set to between 1 and 5 to enable auto recovery. See {@link invalidation-queues.c3doc Invalidation Queues} for detailed documentation.

jobTimeoutMinutes.description: Maximum time allocated for execution of a {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Job} health calculation.

doNotRecoverCanceled.description: Flag to indicate if {@link MlWorkflowCoordinatable#recover} should recover canceled results along with errored results.

modelBatchSize.description:
Number of models to batch together when doing health calculations.
This is the number of models that will be in {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Result#models}.
